label: The worst path to an endpoint
section: The worst path to an endpoint
subgoals: Propagate latest arrivals forward to the endpoint
Read the endpoint arrival as the worst path delay
Backtrace through the fanins that produced each maximum

label: The second-worst path
subgoals: Compute the deviation cost of each non-winning fanin along the worst path
Subtract its cost from the worst delay to get the next path's delay

label: Priority-queue enumeration and reporting
subgoals: Seed a priority queue with the worst path's deviations
Pop the best candidate and push its own deviations
Stop after k paths or at a delay threshold
